title: Jotham, King of Judah
description: Jotham, the son of Uzziah, became king over Judah at the age of twenty-five and reigned for sixteen years. He did what was right in the Lord's eyes, but the high places were not removed. He built the upper gate of the house of the Lord. In his time, the Lord began to send Rezin, king of Aram, and Pekah, son of Remaliah, against Judah. After his death, his son Ahaz became king.
